title: c30 (pyridone) vs c31 (pyrimidinone) on 8Z8A - second-layer validation
method: Vina 1.2.7 energy decomposition (total/inter/intra/torsions) + per-atom electrostatic environment analysis of the docked pose
why_not_MMGBSA: OpenMM 8.3.1 + PDBFixer available but no ambertools/openff-toolkit installable (pip mirror + direct PyPI both blocked by Novo network); GAFF parametrization of small molecules impossible. Replaced with Vina energy decomposition as the second scoring layer.

inter_delta.note: inter = intermolecular interaction energy; the entire total-score gap comes from inter, NOT intra (c31 intra is actually better). Pyrimidinone insertion degrades the binding interface itself.

electrostatic_environment.c31_pyrimidinone_N3_atom: aromatic N at RDKit idx 18 (unique to pyrimidinone; element-MCS diff atom)

distance_to_GLU153_carboxyl.note: Angstrom, min over GLU153 OE1/OE2/CD; 8/8 seeds 3.75-3.83 A = systematic, not pose noise

electrostatic_environment.interpretation: Pyrimidinone ring N3 lone pair sits 3.8 A from the negatively charged GLU153 carboxylate -> electrostatic repulsion; pyridone counterpart is a C-H at the same position (no lone pair). Consistent with the ~4 kcal/mol inter penalty and the 47x EC50 loss (5 nM vs 240 nM).

evidence_levels.electrostatic_repulsion_mechanism: MECH (consistent with both score gap and paper EC50)

caveats: Single rigid cryo-EM conformation; no induced fit or explicit solvent.
Vina inter is not a free energy; treat the 4 kcal/mol as directional structural evidence.
MM/GBSA remains the preferred quantitative check once ambertools/openff is available in this environment.
